positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Member of core development team for app store release of IBM Watson Workspace
• Lead development of networking framework to encapsulate GraphQL and MQTT API interactions
• Maintained >97% code coverage for framework through unit and live integration tests
• Resolved multi-threading bugs for Connections Chat, resulting in 25% reduction in crash reports.

Technologies: iOS, Swift, Git, Jenkins, GraphQL, MQTT

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed GolfNow Apple Watch app for release during the initial Apple Watch launch.
• Executed complete UI/UX overhaul of the Golf Now app on a team of two.
• Refactored views, view controllers, and networking code heavily to reduce redundancy, promote reuse, and simplify future updates.

Technologies: iOS, watchOS, Swift, Objective-C

positions.title: Software Engineer, Intern
positions.description:
• Created iOS app for cocktail recipe search and discovery based on book, 901 Very Good Cocktails.
• Parsed text file of book into structured and cross-­validated JSON files for the document of record.
• Optimized filter page response time by pre­‐computing and caching the result set for all single filters.
• Rapidly prototyped search and filter functionality by creating a web application using AngularJS.
• Lead daily standups in a group of four interns, adhering to agile methodology.

Technologies: iOS, Swift, Angular, Javascript, Python

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: 1801 E Cotati Ave, Rohnert Park, CA 94928
positions.description:
• Developed course schedule searching web and iOS applications.
• Designed an algorithm that parses freeform text into semantic filters used to query the database.
• Developed a data access layer used by both the web and iOS app to retrieve relevant courses.

Technologies: Meteor, Javascript, Mongo, iOS, Objective-C

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
• Created inventory control system to track the flow of $10,000 worth of supplies per month.
• Incorporated a responsive order form to allow painters to request supplies from any device.
• Provided management with a tool to generate cost reports that were previously done by hand.

Technologies: Django, Python, Javascript

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Built websites from design documents and added functionality to already existing sites.
• Repaired and extended modules for a proprietary content management system.
• Maintained legacy code and debugged relatively complex systems.

Technologies: Javascript, PHP
